text:
The body mainly compensates for heat by sweating, since evaporating sweat removes large amounts of heat from the skin, and by vasodilation, which widens skin blood vessels so more heat reaches the surface to be released. It also raises heart output to circulate that blood faster and reduces metabolic heat production. The team note overstates blood flow as the main method: faster circulation helps, but evaporative sweating is the dominant cooling mechanism in heat.

CONFIDENCE: 90
